channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Finance Department turnover delays IW 2024-25 audit to February
item.description: Turnover in Isle of Wight County's finance office has pushed completion of its 2024-25 audit past the Dec. 31 state deadline to February, with the school division's report now expected in March.

item.title: Riverside Smithfield Hospital improving ambulance travel time, data shows
item.description: Since Riverside Smithfield Hospital opened, Isle of Wight and Surry ambulances are reaching their destination faster, cutting turnaround times, fuel use and keeping more units close to home.

item.title: Town Council approves commercial development with drive-thrus by Smithfield Hampton Inn
item.description: Smithfield's Town Council has approved special use permits for a new retail complex with two drive-thru restaurants in front of the Hampton Inn off Benns Church Boulevard.

item.title: Germany in Business Class: Precision, Comfort, and Control
item.description: Germany has a reputation that precedes it precision, reliability, and a deep respect for systems that work well.

item.title: Sundays at Four plans varied lineup for winter-spring season
item.description: Sundays at Four returns Feb. 22 to Christ Episcopal Church with a winter-spring lineup of historical monologues, youth ensembles, The U.S. Air Force Winds from Langley Air Force Base and the annual Terrific Teen Talent recital.

item.title: Column – Smithfield’s new hospital is cause for grand celebration
item.description: Riverside's Close to Home Gala brought a formal flair back to Smithfield, celebrating the new Riverside Smithfield Hospital with donors, moving tributes and star service dog Pop-Tart.

item.title: How to Build Your Fortune in World of Warcraft: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: World of Warcraft is not only about the battle against monsters and dungeons. It has a complicated and living economy.

item.title: Charged for Assault in a Fight in Nevada? What Mutual Combat Really Means and What Happens Next
item.description: Imagine you’re in a heated altercation—one moment, you exchange angry words, and the next, a single punch escalates the situation.

item.title: Former Windsor councilman Randy Carr joins Smithfield Planning Commission
item.description: Former Windsor councilman Randy Carr was appointed to Smithfield's Planning Commission following GiGi Smith's decision to step down.

item.title: BZA to hear rebuilding plan this month for burned Magruder Road house
item.description: Smithfield's Board of Zoning Appeals will weigh a special exception this month that could let a couple keep components of their Magruder Road home during the rebuilding process following a 2024 fire.
